mutant.description: Three mutants run against scratch copies of EDITION_SPECIMEN.md (never against the committed file). Mutant A: truncated to the first 5 lines (title + composed-by line, before any delta word appears) and re-ran AC2's exact invocation. Mutant B: case-sensitively replaced every occurrence of COMPUTED/GENERATED/QUOTED with REDACTED and re-ran AC3's exact invocation. Mutant C: ran AC1/AC4's exact test -f invocation against a deliberately nonexistent sibling filename in the same directory.
mutant.expected: Mutant A must drop AC2's count below 3. Mutant B must drop AC3's count to 0, below the required 3. Mutant C must return rc=1 (no PRESENT) for both the AC1-shaped and AC4-shaped nonexistent-path checks.
mutant.observed: Mutant A: grep -c -E 'worse|better|unchanged' on the 5-line truncation returned 0 (rc=1) -- would FAIL AC2's >=3 bound. Mutant B: grep -c -E 'COMPUTED|GENERATED|QUOTED' on the REDACTED-substituted copy returned 0 (rc=1) -- would FAIL AC3's >=3 bound. Mutant C: test -f against org/.../EDITION_SPECIMEN_NONEXISTENT.md and .../COMPOSER_NONEXISTENT.md both returned rc=1, no PRESENT printed -- would FAIL AC1/AC4. All three mutants fired as designed.
